description: This file defines a node class for conversation summary memory in a chat application, including methods for initializing, retrieving, and managing chat messages and summaries, with integrations to external memory and language model components.

classes.name: ConversationSummaryMemory_Memory
classes.description: A node class implementing conversation summary memory with initialization and message retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: ConversationSummaryMemoryExtended
classes.description: An extension of FlowiseSummaryMemory that manages chat message retrieval and summarization, integrating with a database and language models.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the memory node with configuration data and returns a new ConversationSummaryMemoryExtended instance.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages from the database, optionally prepends messages, and generates or returns summaries based on the language model.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder for adding chat messages, managed at server level.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Placeholder for clearing chat messages, managed at server level.
